title: GraphQL Relay Cursor Pagination — Runnable Server
title_es: Paginación por cursores Relay en GraphQL — Servidor ejecutable
description: Runnable Apollo Server implementing the Relay Connection spec: Connection/Edge/PageInfo types, base64 cursor encoding, bidirectional first/after + last/before resolver, and an in-memory post store to try queries immediately.
description_es: Servidor Apollo ejecutable que implementa la especificación Relay Connection: tipos Connection/Edge/PageInfo, codificación de cursores base64, resolver bidireccional first/after + last/before y un store en memoria para probar queries al instante.
